title: DPA & 19AB Eligibility Navigator — UX journey
purpose: Help prospective doctors explore potential pathway questions before an EOI — without determining eligibility or giving legal/migration advice.

alwaysVisible: This navigator does not determine your eligibility under DPA or Health Insurance Act s19AB.
It does not provide legal advice or migration advice.
Official decisions are made by Services Australia / relevant government programs — not Woolloongabba Medical Centre.
WMC can share practice location details and discuss onboarding; it cannot grant exemptions or issue provider numbers.

stages.name: Orient
stages.goal: Set expectations: exploration tool, not an eligibility decision.

stages.name: Capture
stages.goal: Collect pathway-relevant facts the doctor already knows.

stages.name: Summarise
stages.goal: Show pathway themes, discussion questions, docs, SA links, next action.
stages.exitCriteria: Doctor chooses EOI, save JSON, or revisit answers

stages.name: Handoff
stages.goal: Optional EOI or call — practice conversation, not automated determination.

mobileRules: One primary question group per step
Progress = step N of capture count
